newsDocuments.headline: Govt reduces petrol price by Rs3.93 per litre, keeps diesel's unchanged

segments.text: The government on Friday reduced the price of petrol by Rs3.93 to Rs386.30 per litre, while keeping the price of high-speed diesel (HSD) unchanged at Rs396.96 per litre. The new prices will remain in effect from October 17 to October 19, 20

According to a press release issued by the Petroleum Division, the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) revised the ex-depot prices of petroleum products in line with the petroleum pricing mechanism set by the federal government.
The Petroleum Division said the revision was driven by global developments, including changes in Platts rates, premiums and incidentals.
